selection: Two additional economic hypotheses, fixed before their outcomes; no parameter sweep. All five asset cells retained, with explicit ineligible universes.
weekly: BTC/ETH only. One daily decision at 00:00UTC. Asset and BTC positive 7d and30d returns; asset 7d >=5%, 30d >=10%; yesterday positive. Stop two daily ATR14; target3R; maximum7days. Long-only risk-on condition.
shock: BTC/ETH/SOL only. Previous hour marks a new24h low; asset previous24h <=-8% and previous6h <=-4%; current close above previous high and current return >=1%; current quote volume >=2x preceding24h mean; BTC previous6h negative. Stop below previous/current lows or2 hourly ATR20, whichever wider; target3R; maximum12h.
qualification: Minimum1% stop distance; target gross move >=5x declared round-trip costs. One active per asset/hypothesis. Native15m next-open fills, original stops, full target, conservative collision handling.
evidence: Previously examined development data; fixed surviving assets; independent signal outcomes, not portfolio/Prop/live fills. Funding is a reserve, not historical measured payments.
